topic.title: Duosmium Instructions
topic.shortdesc: Duosmium exists as a way to view Science Olympiad Tournament scores, the site created by smayya337, Sciolyperson1, and Person-v132, but it also offers a scoring tool! It's a very useful setup, but you may encounter some difficulty with using it. Never fear, this guide is here to answer any questions you may have and offer whatever help you may need.
